problems.title: E3.1 - Special QR Decomposition in 2D
problems.snippet: Derives QR decomposition for 2×2 matrix \(A = [[a,b],[c,d]]\) using geometric insight. For orthogonal vector to \([\alpha, \beta]^T\), use \([-\beta, \alpha]^T\). Shows \(Q = (1/\sqrt{a^2+c^2})[[a, -c], [c, a]]\) and derives upper-triangular \(R\).

problems.title: E3.2 - Linear Regression
problems.snippet: Linear regression through mean-centered data in 2D. Given data matrix \(D = [[3,-4,7,1,-4,-3], [7,-6,8,-1,-1,-7]]\), find best-fit line \(y = mx\) through origin using least squares: \(\hat{m} = (a^T a)^{-1}a^T b\). Computes \(a^T a = 100\) and \(a^T b = 125\), yielding \(m = 1.25\).

problems.title: E3.3 - The Golden State Space
problems.snippet: State-space system generating Fibonacci sequence: \(q[n+1] = [[1,1],[1,0]]q[n]\). Eigenvalues are golden ratio \(\phi = (1+\sqrt{5})/2 \approx 1.618\) and \(\hat{\phi} = (1-\sqrt{5})/2 \approx -0.618\). Derives Binet's formula: \(y[n] = (\phi^{n+1} - \hat{\phi}^{n+1})/\sqrt{5}\). Shows \(\lim_{n\to\infty} y[n+1]/y[n] = \phi\).

problems.title: E3.4 - Basic SVD
problems.snippet: Computes compact SVD of \(A = [[3,2],[1,0],[0,\sqrt{6}]]\) giving \(A = U\Sigma V^T\). Finds \(A^T A = [[10,6],[6,10]]\) with eigenvalues \(\lambda_1 = 16, \lambda_2 = 4\), yielding singular values \(\sigma_1 = 4, \sigma_2 = 2\). Constructs \(V\) from eigenvectors of \(A^T A\) and \(U\) from \(Av_i/\sigma_i\).

problems.title: E3.5 - Using PCA to Analyze Bacteria
problems.snippet: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on gene-expression data to classify bacteria species. Centers data matrix, computes covariance matrix \(C = XX^T/n\), finds eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Projects data onto principal components for dimensionality reduction and species classification.

problems.title: MT3.1 - Hide and Seek
problems.snippet: Change of basis and eigenvalue decomposition. Given transformation \(T\) with eigenvalues \(\lambda_i\) and eigenvectors \(v_i\), represents as \(T = V\Lambda V^{-1}\). Analyzes coordinate transformations using change-of-basis matrix \(x = Cz\).

problems.title: MT3.2 - Ridge Regression
problems.snippet: Compares standard least squares \(\hat{x} = (A^T A)^{-1}A^T b\) with ridge regression \(\hat{x} = (A^T A + \eta I)^{-1}A^T b\). Shows L2 regularization makes \(A^T A + \eta I\) invertible by shifting eigenvalues: \(\lambda_i \to \lambda_i + \eta > 0\).

problems.title: MT3.3 - Robot Grasping with PCA
problems.snippet: Uses PCA for object pose estimation. Finds center \((\bar{x}, \bar{y})\) of point cloud, computes covariance matrix, and identifies major axis as first principal component (largest eigenvalue). Applies state-space model \(x[i+1] = Bx[i] + cu[i]\) for motion planning using SVD for least-norm solution.

problems.title: MT3.4 - Damped Harmonic Oscillator
problems.snippet: Models continuous-time system \(\ddot{y} = -c\dot{y} - ky\) as state-space \(dx/dt = Ax\) where \(x = [y, \dot{y}]^T\). Analyzes stability using eigenvalues (stable if \(\text{Re}(\lambda) < 0\)). Solution \(x(t) = e^{At}x(0) = V e^{\Lambda t}V^{-1}x(0)\).

problems.title: Q4 - Strike a Chord
problems.snippet: Inner products, angles between vectors, orthogonality. Computes \(\cos(\theta) = \langle a,b \rangle / (||a|| ||b||)\) for multiple vector pairs. Determines when vectors are orthogonal (\(\langle a,b \rangle = 0\)).

problems.title: Q6 - Let's Go, Mooncow!
problems.snippet: Vector operations, projections, transformations, least-squares. Projects vector \(b\) onto column space of \(A\): \(\hat{b} = A(A^T A)^{-1}A^T b\). Computes projection error \(e = b - \hat{b}\) orthogonal to \(C(A)\).

problems.title: Q8 - Aficiona-dough
problems.snippet: State transitions and Markov chains. Given transition matrix \(P\), analyzes steady state where \(x[\infty] = Px[\infty]\) (eigenvalue 1). Determines convergence conditions using eigenvalue analysis: \(|\lambda| < 1\) for all other eigenvalues ensures convergence.

problems.title: Q9 - Proofs
problems.snippet: Nullspace properties and eigenvectors. Proves if \(v\) is eigenvector of \(A\) with eigenvalue \(\lambda\), then either \(v \in N(A - \lambda I)\) or \(Av = \lambda v\). Explores relationship between nullspace and eigenspaces.

problems.title: Q10 - Orthonormal Least Squares
problems.snippet: Projection onto column space with orthonormal columns. When \(Q^T Q = I\), projection simplifies to \(P = QQ^T\) and \(\hat{x} = Q^T b\). Shows orthogonality of residual: \(\langle e, Qx \rangle = 0\) for any \(x\).

problems.title: Q4 - Least Squares in Pictures
problems.snippet: Visual interpretation of least squares. Column space \(C(A)\), projection \(\hat{b} = A\hat{x}\), and error \(e = b - \hat{b} \perp C(A)\). Shows geometrically why \(A^T(b - A\hat{x}) = 0\) leads to normal equations \(A^T A\hat{x} = A^T b\).

problems.title: Q5 - Battleships
problems.snippet: Linear regression for trajectory prediction. Formulates overdetermined system \(Ax = b\) where \(A\) contains observation data. Solves \(\hat{x} = (A^T A)^{-1}A^T b\) to minimize squared error \(||Ax - b||^2\).

problems.title: Q9 - Noisy Imaging Revisited
problems.snippet: Masking matrices and eigenvalues in image processing. For diagonal masking matrix \(M\), analyzes \(N(M)\) (pixels to remove) and \(C(M)\) (pixels to keep). Uses least squares \(\hat{x} = (A^T A)^{-1}A^T b\) with noise to reconstruct image.

problems.title: Q10 - Charge Pumps
problems.snippet: Charge distribution system \(q[n+1] = Pq[n]\) where \(P\) is transition matrix. Finds steady state by solving \((P - I)q_{ss} = 0\) or as eigenvector for \(\lambda = 1\). Analyzes convergence rate using second-largest eigenvalue \(|\lambda_2|\).

problems.title: Q11 - Fun with EECS16(AB)
problems.snippet: Invertibility and nullspace proofs. If \(AB\) is invertible, proves both \(A\) and \(B\) must be invertible. Shows \(N(AB) = \{0\}\) implies \(N(B) = \{0\}\) using \(ABx = 0 \Rightarrow Bx \in N(A)\).

problems.title: Q3 - Least Squares
problems.snippet: Standard least squares problem. Given overdetermined system \(Ax = b\), finds \(\hat{x}\) minimizing \(||Ax - b||^2\). Derives normal equations \(A^T A\hat{x} = A^T b\). Computes projection \(\hat{b} = A\hat{x}\) and residual \(e = b - \hat{b}\).

problems.title: Q5 - Eigenstuff
problems.snippet: Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and eigenspaces. Given matrix \(A\), finds characteristic polynomial \(\det(A - \lambda I) = 0\). Solves for eigenvectors from \((A - \lambda I)v = 0\). Analyzes eigenspace dimensions and geometric/algebraic multiplicities.

problems.title: Q10 - Orthogonal Space
problems.snippet: Orthogonality with respect to subspaces. Given subspace \(V\), finds orthogonal complement \(V^{\perp} = \{w : \langle v,w \rangle = 0 \text{ for all } v \in V\}\). Verifies \(\dim(V) + \dim(V^{\perp}) = n\) and \(V \cap V^{\perp} = \{0\}\).

problems.title: Q11 - Mixed signals?
problems.snippet: Fits sinusoidal model to noisy data. Given measurements, formulates \(y(t) = a\cos(\omega t) + b\sin(\omega t)\) as linear system \(Ax = b\) where \(A = [[\cos(\omega t_1), \sin(\omega t_1)], ...]\). Solves using least squares to find amplitude and phase.

problems.title: Q4 - Eurovision Song Contest
problems.snippet: Ranking system using eigenvectors. Constructs preference matrix \(P\) where \(P_{ij}\) represents votes from country \(i\) to \(j\). Ranking is principal eigenvector (largest eigenvalue) of \(P\): solves \(Pv = \lambda v\). Related to PageRank algorithm.

problems.title: Q6 - R-I-P Loads
problems.snippet: Power consumption modeling using least squares. Given voltage and current measurements, fits model \(P = aV^2 + bV + c\) for resistive, inductive, and constant power loads. Formulates as \(Ax = b\) and solves \(\hat{x} = (A^T A)^{-1}A^T b\).

problems.title: Q7 - Danville Doozy
problems.snippet: Conservative state transition system. Matrix \(P\) is column-stochastic: columns sum to 1, preserving total quantity. Proves steady state exists as eigenvector for \(\lambda = 1\): \(Px_{ss} = x_{ss}\). Analyzes convergence using spectral radius \(\rho(P - I) < 1\).

problems.title: Q12 - Eigenvalues Galore
problems.snippet: Properties of eigenvalues under matrix operations. If \(\lambda\) is eigenvalue of \(A\), shows: \(\lambda^k\) is eigenvalue of \(A^k\), \(\lambda + c\) is eigenvalue of \(A + cI\), and \(c\lambda\) is eigenvalue of \(cA\). Proves using \(Av = \lambda v\).

problems.title: Q3 - Linear Algebra
problems.snippet: Gaussian elimination and fundamental subspaces. Reduces matrix to row echelon form to identify pivot columns (basis for \(C(A)\)) and free variables (basis for \(N(A)\)). Verifies rank-nullity theorem: \(\text{rank}(A) + \dim(N(A)) = n\). Computes inner products to verify orthogonality.

problems.title: Q4 - Transitioning Back to Campus
problems.snippet: Population dynamics model for campus reopening. State \(x[n] = [\text{on-campus}, \text{off-campus}]^T\) evolves as \(x[n+1] = Px[n]\). Matrix \(P\) is doubly stochastic (rows and columns sum to 1), ensuring steady state \(x_{ss} = [1/2, 1/2]^T\). Eigenvalue 1 guarantees convergence.

problems.title: Q9 - Cool Predictions
problems.snippet: Temperature prediction using polynomial regression. Fits model \(T(t) = a_0 + a_1 t + a_2 t^2\) to historical data using least squares. Formulates Vandermonde matrix \(A = [[1, t_1, t_1^2], ...]\) and solves \(\hat{a} = (A^T A)^{-1}A^T b\). Computes prediction error \(||A\hat{a} - b||^2\).

problems.title: Q10 - Symmetric and PSD Matrices
problems.snippet: Properties of symmetric and positive semi-definite (PSD) matrices. For symmetric \(A\), proves eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal: \(\lambda_i \neq \lambda_j \Rightarrow v_i \perp v_j\). Shows PSD means \(x^T Ax \geq 0\) for all \(x\), equivalent to all eigenvalues \(\lambda_i \geq 0\).

problems.title: Q1 - A Quirky Quantum Question
problems.snippet: Quantum mechanics application with Hermitian matrices. For symmetric matrix \(H\), finds eigenvalues (energy levels) and orthonormal eigenvectors (quantum states). Verifies \(H = Q\Lambda Q^T\) spectral decomposition. Computes probabilities using \(|\langle \psi, v_i \rangle|^2\).

problems.title: Q3 - Least Squares with Shazam
problems.snippet: Audio signal matching using projections and cross-correlation. Projects query signal onto reference signals to find best match. Computes \(\hat{x} = (A^T A)^{-1}A^T b\) where columns of \(A\) are reference signals. Uses \(\langle a_i, b \rangle\) to measure similarity.

problems.title: Q12 - Orthogonality
problems.snippet: Orthogonality with custom inner product \(\langle f,g \rangle_w = \int f(x)g(x)w(x)dx\). Given weight function \(w(x)\), verifies orthogonality of polynomials. Applies Gram-Schmidt with weighted inner product to construct orthogonal polynomial basis.

problems.title: Q15 - Charge Sharing Cycles
problems.snippet: Capacitor charge redistribution network. Discrete-time model \(q[n+1] = Mq[n]\) where \(M\) represents charge sharing. Finds steady state by solving \((M - I)q_{ss} = 0\). Matrix \(M\) is doubly stochastic, ensuring charge conservation and unique steady state.

problems.title: Q16 - Linear Algebra Circuit
problems.snippet: Circuit analysis with matrix equations. Represents circuit using \(Ax = b\) where \(A\) is incidence or admittance matrix. Determines when system has unique solution (\(A\) invertible), no solution (\(b \notin C(A)\)), or infinite solutions (\(\dim(N(A)) > 0\)). Uses least squares for overdetermined case.
